2607.18142.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
2607.18142.paper_summary: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection (IVAD) aims to identify anomalous objects and events in an industrial process, which is crucial for modern manufacturing and quality control systems. Existing VLM-based anomaly reasoning methods are capable of detecting open-ended anomalies in general domains. However, their performance declines in industrial settings characterized by intricate object transformations, strict physics, and procedural constraints. To tackle the complexity of such interaction-intensive detection, we introduce a training-free agentic framework for anomaly detection free of domain-specific knowledge, emphasizing object state evolution like humans inspectors. It is designed to track spatial-temporal dynamics and underlying transformations of detected objects over time, and then reason over the object-wise temporal state trajectories to identify abnormal objects in grounded frames. Our method overcomes limitations of prior approaches that rely on retraining on normal clips or injecting domain knowledge as context for test-time inference. Extensive experiments on three IVAD datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms frontier VLMs, agentic frameworks, and traditional VAD methods fine-tuned on the respective datasets, while providing interpretable reports over anomaly processes and types.
2607.18142.paper_summary_zh: 工業視頻異常檢測（IVAD）旨在識別工業過程中的異常物體和事件，這對於現代製造和質量控制系統至關重要。現有的基於VLM的異常推理方法能夠檢測一般領域中的開放式異常。然而，它們在特徵複雜的工業環境中的性能下降，這些環境以複雜的物體轉換、嚴格的物理規範和程序約束為特徵。為了應對這種互動密集型檢測的複雜性，我們引入了一種無需訓練的代理框架，用於異常檢測，無需特定領域的知識，強調物體狀態的演變，類似於人類檢查員。該框架旨在跟踪檢測物體的空間-時間動態及其潛在轉變，然後對物體的時間狀態軌跡進行推理，以識別基於實體框架的異常物體。我們的方法克服了先前依賴於正常片段重訓練或將領域知識作為測試時推理上下文的限制。在三個IVAD數據集上的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法在性能上超越了前沿的VLM、代理框架和在各自數據集上微調的傳統VAD方法，同時提供了對異常過程和類型的可解釋報告。
